title: Wideband Backscatter Radar Target
text: 从雷达目标后向散射宽带信号，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；按 {Azimuth angles (deg)} 指定方位角；{Backscatter pattern frequency vector (Hz)} 指定宽带后向散射方向图频率、{Elevation angles (deg)} 指定俯仰角、{RCS pattern (m^2)} 指定雷达截面积方向图 ones、{Fluctuation model} 指定目标起伏模型、{Propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Operating frequency (Hz)} 指定信号载频 300.0e6、{Inherit sample rate} 指定从上游模块继承采样率、{Sample rate (Hz)} 指定信号采样率 1e6、{Number of subbands} 指定处理子带数、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 宽带入射非极化信号 N -by- 1 complex-valued vector | N -by- M complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: 入射信号方向 2-by-1 real-valued column vector | 2-by- M real-valued column matrix

ports.name: Update
ports.summary: 用于更新 RCS 的开关 false | true

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 窄带反射信号 1-by- M complex-valued vector | N -by- M complex-valued matrix

params.name: Backscatter pattern frequency vector (Hz)
params.values: 宽带后向散射方向图频率 [0,1e20] (default) | real-valued row vector of positive values in strictly increasing order

params.name: Azimuth angles (deg)
params.values: 方位角 [-180:180] (default) | 1-by- P real-valued row vector | P -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: Elevation angles (deg)
params.values: 俯仰角 [-90:90] (default) | 1-by- Q real-valued row vector | Q -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: RCS pattern (m^2)
params.values: 雷达截面积方向图 ones(181,361) (default) | Q -by- P real-valued matrix | Q -by- P -by- K real-valued array | 1-by- P -by- K real-valued array | K -by- P real-valued matrix

params.name: Fluctuation model
params.values: 目标起伏模型 Nonfluctuating (default) | Swerling1 | Swerling2 | Swerling3 | Swerling4

params.name: Propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Operating frequency (Hz)
params.values: 信号载频 300.0e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: 从上游模块继承采样率 on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 信号采样率 1e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
